FACILITY   (SYNCY,2ZZZCER) CERN nTOF facility (EAR1, EAR2)        2367900100074 
           Protons (7E+12 protons/pulse, pulse width of 7 nsec)   2367900100075 
            were accelerated to 20 GeV/c with repetition rate of  2367900100076 
            0.83 Hz at maximum.                                   2367900100077 
INC-SOURCE (SPALL) Neutrons were produced in a cylindrical Pb     2367900100078 
            spallation target (40 cm in length, 60 cm in diameter)2367900100079 
           Neutrons were moderated by surrounding water layer.    2367900100080 
SAMPLE     The samples used in the experiment were acquired by    2367900100081 
            the Japan Atomic Energy Agency (JAEA) from the        2367900100082 
            Russian Research Institute of Atomic Research in 2007.2367900100083 
           The sample consists of two Cm oxide pellets with       2367900100084 
            dimensions of 2.5 mm in radius and 0.5 mm in height,  2367900100085 
            enclosed in an aluminum casing.                       2367900100086 
           Samples from the same batch material were used in      2367900100087 
            previous measurements by Kimura (2012) and Kawase     2367900100088 
            (2021).                                               2367900100089 
DETECTOR   (SI) The neutron flux was measured during the          2367900100090 
            experiment by SiMoN and SiMoN2 6Li(n,t)               2367900100091 
ANALYSIS   The measurements were normalized to the first          2367900100092 
            resonance of Pu-240 at 1.056 eV using the JEFF-3.3    2367900100093 
            library. This isotope is also present in the sample.  2367900100094 
           To perform this normalization, the sample masses were  2367900100095 
            adjusted to match this Pu-240 resonance.              2367900100096 
CORRECTION Backgrounds subtracted:                                2367900100097 
           - Dummy sample (Al canning)                            2367900100098 
           - No sample                                            2367900100099 
           - Elastic scattering assuming an efficiency to detect  2367900100100 
             a neutron proportional to its energy (only for EAR1) 2367900100101 
           - Fission assuming a constant efficiency to detect the 2367900100102 
             fission events                                       2367900100103 
           - Activity of the sample                               2367900100104
